decisions.reason: The approved Option 2 Hero V was already the current geometry reference. Making its terminal the literal source of the É accent does not alter the Hero V geometry itself.
The existing message-118 MODIFY already records that the shared gesture is exact and that the É accent is literally formed from the approved Hero V terminal section.
The existing message-118 MODIFY already records use of the approved Option 2 Hero V signature gesture in the lowercase closing v. The new literal-termination rule specifically refines the É accent.
The decision concerns derivation of the É accent from the Hero V terminal and does not change the deferred construction rules for the E and L letterforms.
The accent-derivation decision does not change the requirement to provide design rationale with review rounds.
The geometric relationship between the Hero V and É accent does not change the deferred champagne material treatment.
Literal derivation of the É accent does not entail any change to the deferred wordmark kerning requirement.
Unifying the signature gesture does not change the closing V's established smaller, subordinate visual prominence.
The design decision has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats.
